Go One Update Back

This reverses the latest reversible history entry for every person record. Records with no reversible latest update or a conflicting change will be skipped. Existing history is retained.

Load JSON Backup

Preview the records and every changed field before applying. Matching records are updated only for fields included in the backup; existing database IDs and creation timestamps are retained.

Select a count to inspect names. For changed records, expand a row to inspect the old and incoming field values. Lists show 50 records per page.
